"Hello!

If you're interested in changing your ugly appearance, I can make you look decent! However, nothing is free in Midgard, so you should pay me with something valuable.

First, you need two items. One is the Target item, or the item you want to equip for it's stats and effects. The second item is the one you want the appearance of.

Second, the item for Appearance will be consumed and it's appearance will be transmogrified to the Target item, including the dye color.

Fourth, the Target item will be marked with [Unable to Shapeshift] which means the item cannot be consumed as an Appearance ingredient in a future transmogrification.

Fifth, you have to pay me Diamonds and Zeny for this work. I said nothing is free!

Sixth, we only have costumes for armor right now, since weapons take longer to make. You can still transmogrify your weapons, but you need to provide your own. Also, only similar armor types can be applied to other similar armor types. Cloth for cloth, and so on.

And that's it! So, what do you say? Are you ready to stop being ugly, and start being beautiful?"
